## Numerical authority and claim limits

The approved program-order and conditional-composition decisions retain their
existing scope. `FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD v0.1` remains a required-record family;
no numerical method-specific instance is approved by this freeze. The core
freeze creates no method Registry or activation record. All numerical
conformance comparisons remain blocked and numerical evidence artifacts are
not produced.

No scientific freeze implies implementation conformity, response/covariance
fidelity, uncertainty coverage, recovered measured modes, convergence adequacy,
downstream fitness, observational validation, readiness or production
authorization. No numerical experiment, replay, qualification, reduction,
Unity activity or production operation is authorized by this record.

## Recommended next disposition

The next substantive proposal is a bounded definition of one numerical FRUIT
method for one intended scientific use and exact parent route. Begin with
method-specific prior-work recovery and a scope brief separating authoritative
science, owner choices and unavailable inputs. Use the frozen core and its
[twenty-one-class method record](stage_b_from_r0.4_amended/r0.4/METHOD_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md)
to expose the actual operator, model, grouping, update, support, response,
uncertainty, continuation, stopping and terminal-selection decisions. No
unresolved field is filled from a software default or familiar practice.

Return that exact method proposal and required upstream permissions for
separate owner approval before numerical use. Implementation assessment,
conformance evidence and subsequent scientific validation require their own
bounded scope and authorization. This recommendation launches no new author,
method derivation, implementation assessment or numerical work.
